flows.text:
sequenceDiagram
  participant n0 as Stripe
  participant n1 as Order API
  participant n2 as Order events
  participant n3 as Delivery
  participant n4 as Back office
  n0->>n1: Reports that the charge went through
  Note over n1: Continues in #quot;Stripe reports a charge#quot;
  n1->>n2: Publishes the paid event and carries on without waiting
  par Delivery
    n2->>n3: Dispatch consumes it and starts looking for a courier
    Note over n3: Continues in #quot;A courier delivers it#quot;
  and Warehouse
    n2->>n4: Streams the same event to the warehouse
  end

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Restaurant
  participant n1 as Kitchen tablet
  participant n2 as Order API
  participant n3 as Stripe
  participant n4 as Orders DB
  participant n5 as Customer app
  actor n6 as Customer
  n0->>n1: The kitchen taps Accept
  Note over n1: Continues in #quot;The restaurant accepts#quot;
  n1->>n2: Sends the acceptance
  loop Up to 3 times, until the bank answers: Waits 1 s, then 2 s, then 4 s between tries. Plum's client gives up after three.
    n2->>n3: Captures the amount it held
    Note over n2,n3: Times out
    Note over n2: Times out after 5 s and retries
  end
  alt The charge goes through
    n3->>n2: Confirms the charge
    n2->>n4: Marks the order paid
  else The card is declined
    n3->>n2: Declines the card
    Note over n3,n2: Fails
    n2->>n5: Asks for another card
    n5->>n6: Shows that the card was declined
  end

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Courier
  participant n1 as Courier app
  participant n2 as Live tracking
  participant n3 as Ordering
  actor n4 as Customer
  participant n5 as Fleet DB
  n0->>n1: Rides into streets with a weak signal
  n1->>n2: About a third of the pings are lost on the way
  Note over n1,n2: 30% lost: Packet dropped
  n2->>n3: Sends the positions that did arrive
  n3->>n4: The courier jumps across the map
  Note over n5: Keeps the last position it got

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Ordering
  participant n2 as Dispatch
  participant n3 as Fleet DB
  participant n4 as Mapbox
  participant n5 as Notifications
  actor n6 as Courier
  participant n7 as Courier app
  actor n8 as Restaurant
  participant n9 as Live tracking
  n0->>n1: Places an order
  Note over n1: Continues in #quot;Customer places an order#quot;
  n1->>n2: The placed order reaches Dispatch
  n2->>n3: Finds idle couriers near the restaurant
  n2->>n4: Asks Mapbox how far each courier is
  n2->>n5: Sends the offer as a push
  n6->>n7: Accepts within 30 seconds
  n8->>n6: Hands the food over at the counter
  n7->>n9: Streams its position every 5 seconds
  Note over n9: Continues in #quot;The customer follows the courier#quot;
  n9->>n1: The customer's map follows the courier
  n6->>n0: Hands the food over at the door
  n7->>n1: Marks the order delivered

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Ordering
  participant n2 as Dispatch
  participant n3 as Fleet DB
  n0->>n1: Places an order in the dinner rush
  Note over n1: Continues in #quot;Customer places an order#quot;
  n1->>n2: The placed event waits behind the dinner rush
  Note over n1,n2: Delayed: Consumer lag
  n2->>n3: Finds couriers minutes after the customer paid

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Ordering
  participant n2 as Live tracking
  participant n3 as Courier app
  participant n4 as Fleet DB
  n0->>n1: Opens the order to see where the food is
  n1->>n2: Opens the live map
  Note over n1,n2: Opens a stream: Live map
  loop Until the order is delivered: A position every 5 s.
    n3->>n2: Sends its position
    n2->>n4: Stores it
    n2->>n1: Moves the courier on the customer's map
  end
  n3->>n1: Marks the order delivered
  n1->>n2: Closes the live map
  Note over n1,n2: Closes Live map

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Customer app
  participant n2 as Order API
  n0->>n1: Taps Place order on the hotel wifi
  n1->>n2: POST /orders reaches a sign-in page instead
  Note over n1,n2: Taken by Hotel wifi portal
  Note over n1: Waits for a reply and offers a Retry button

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Ordering
  participant n2 as Matcher
  participant n3 as ETA
  participant n4 as Mapbox
  n0->>n1: Places one of 900 orders in a minute
  Note over n1: Continues in #quot;Customer places an order#quot;
  n1->>n2: The placed order reaches the Matcher
  n2->>n3: Asks who is quickest
  n3->>n4: Asks Mapbox for travel times and is turned away
  Note over n3,n4: Rejected: Rate limit
  Note over n3: Falls back to straight-line distance and ranks more roughly

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Customer app
  participant n2 as Menu
  participant n3 as Menu cache
  participant n4 as Orders DB
  n0->>n1: Opens a restaurant
  n1->>n2: Asks for a restaurant's menu
  n2->>n3: Looks the menu up
  alt Cache hit
    n3->>n2: Returns the cached menu
  else Cache miss
    n2->>n4: Reads the menu from the database
    n2->>n3: Caches it for 5 min
  end
  n2->>n1: Returns the menu
  n1->>n0: Shows the dishes and prices

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Ordering
  participant n2 as Dispatch
  participant n3 as Notifications
  actor n4 as Courier
  participant n5 as Courier app
  n0->>n1: Places an order
  Note over n1: Continues in #quot;Customer places an order#quot;
  n1->>n2: The placed order reaches Dispatch
  loop Until a courier accepts, or the list runs out: One courier at a time, nearest first. Each has 30 seconds.
    n2->>n3: Offers the job#59; the nearest courier doesn't answer in 30 s
    Note over n2,n3: Times out: No answer in 30 s
    Note over n2: Moves on to the next courier on the list
  end
  alt A courier accepts
    n4->>n5: A courier taps Accept
    n5->>n2: The offers stop
  else The list runs out
    n2->>n3: Tells the customer that no courier is free yet
    Note over n2: Searches again in a minute
  end

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Customer app
  participant n2 as Order API
  participant n3 as Kitchen tablet
  participant n4 as Stripe
  participant n5 as Orders DB
  n0->>n1: Places an order
  Note over n1: Continues in #quot;Customer places an order#quot;
  n2->>n3: Rings the restaurant's tablet and gets no answer
  Note over n2,n3: Times out: Tablet offline
  Note over n2: Waits two minutes, then cancels the order
  n2->>n4: Releases the hold on the card
  n2->>n5: Marks the order cancelled
  n2->>n1: Tells the customer the restaurant couldn't take it

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Customer app
  participant n2 as Order API
  participant n3 as Orders DB
  n0->>n1: Taps Place order, and again when nothing seems to happen
  n1->>n2: The same order arrives twice
  Note over n1,n2: Sent twice: Slow reply
  n2->>n3: Saves the first copy and refuses the second

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Customer app
  participant n2 as Order API
  participant n3 as Orders DB
  n0->>n1: Taps Place order
  n1->>n2: POST /orders with the basket
  n2->>n3: A write gets no answer, because the primary has failed
  Note over n2,n3: Times out: Primary is down
  Note over n3: Stopped
  n2->>n1: Asks the customer to try again in a minute
  Note over n2: Degraded
  Note over n3: A standby takes over as the primary
  Note over n3: Starting
  n2->>n3: The next write goes through
  Note over n3: Running
  Note over n2: Running

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Customer
  participant n1 as Customer app
  participant n2 as Order API
  participant n3 as Stripe
  participant n4 as Orders DB
  participant n5 as Order events
  participant n6 as Delivery
  participant n7 as Kitchen tablet
  n0->>n1: Fills a basket and taps Place order
  n1->>n2: POST /orders with the basket
  n2->>n3: Holds the amount on the card
  n2->>n4: Saves the order as placed
  n2->>n5: Publishes the order
  n5->>n6: Dispatch starts looking for a courier
  Note over n6: Continues in #quot;A courier delivers it#quot;
  n2->>n7: The restaurant's tablet rings

sequenceDiagram
  participant n0 as Basket
  participant n1 as Pricing
  n0->>n1: Asks for the total of a basket that holds a meal deal
  n1->>n1: Prices a deal by pricing each of its parts, down to plain items that have a price
  n1->>n0: Hands back the total

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Support agent
  participant n1 as Back office
  participant n2 as Order API
  participant n3 as Stripe
  participant n4 as Orders DB
  participant n5 as Notifications
  n0->>n1: Asks for a refund in the support console
  n1->>n2: Sends the refund to the Order API
  n2->>n3: Stripe has refunded the charge
  n2->>n4: Can't mark the order refunded, because Orders DB doesn't answer
  Note over n2,n4: Times out
  Note over n2: Leaves the order marked paid, though the money is back
  n2->>n5: Still sends the customer a refund confirmation

sequenceDiagram
  actor n0 as Support agent
  participant n1 as Back office
  participant n2 as Ordering
  participant n3 as Stripe
  participant n4 as Notifications
  participant n5 as Twilio

  n2->>n4: Requests a confirmation
  n4->>n5: Hands the SMS to Twilio
